Base directory for this skill: <HOME>\repos\wiki-master-worktrees\five-skills\skills\wiki-maintainer

# Maintaining the wiki

Select the requested mode; read [access](references/access.md) and only the
references relevant to that mode. Treat `` as the request when the host
has not substituted it.

- **Health, structural defects or backlog counts:** [health](references/health.md)
  and [metrics](references/maintenance.md). Reporting does not process clippings.
- **Freshness and what needs factual review:** [freshness](references/stale.md).
- **Consistency, contradictions, unsupported quotes and factual fixes:**
  [lint](references/lint.md) and [evidence](references/evidence.md).
  For quotation-pairing and style-flag mechanics, read the
  [content lint contract](../../README.md#content-lint).
- **Broken citations or integrity worklist repairs:** [repair](references/repair.md).
- **Useful relationships, forward links, orphan navigation and task maps:**
  [relink](references/relink.md) and [identity and relationships](references/efficacy.md).
- **Clipping failures, fidelity flags, declines and human decisions:**
  [triage](references/triage.md). Presenting the UI creates only local session
  state; applying dispositions is a separate action. Before applying re-clips or
  quarantine, read [re-clipping and quarantine](../../docs/reclipping.md).
- **Native Obsidian mechanics when a maintenance step needs them:**
  [Obsidian commands](references/obsidian-cli.md). Requested app actions also
  route here from wiki-user; ordinary file work does not require the app.

Health, freshness and preview reports do not open operations, log, commit or
refresh indexes. Before applying authorized changes, read
[evidence](references/evidence.md) and [operation completion](references/operations.md).
Keep reports distinct from mutations; a request for a report does not authorize
repairs. Preserve raw bodies and foreign edits, validate the actual changed
paths, and finish scoped publication unless the user holds it. Purge keeps its
separate plan and publication approvals in [wiki-purge](../wiki-purge/SKILL.md).

A clean graph does not prove factual accuracy. During substantive maintenance,
use cheap structural checks and a bounded review of changed or high-use pages;
skip an empty vault and avoid a full lint of an unchanged wiki. Preserve factual
review dates on mechanical edits and report coverage limits. For cross-mode
orientation only, see the [workflow overview](references/workflows.md).
Mode is relink. I'll read access, relink and efficacy.

vault layout. Read local `AGENTS.md` and schema before edits. A known root and

the user to restart Obsidian as a prerequisite for all work.

`raw/clippings/` holds captured evidence; `wiki/{sources,entities,concepts,syntheses,authored}/`
holds maintained pages; `moc/` holds navigational maps; `log/` holds one file per
operation. Never read, cite or count `.recycle/`; only purge owns it. Reads do not
open operations, write logs, commit or refresh indexes. Before any authorized
mutation, read [operation completion](operations.md); before quoting or
synthesizing, read [evidence](evidence.md).

Prefer bounded search and relevant MOCs to the generated catalog. Search
diagnostics describe coverage, not relevance: a stale index can omit useful pages.
Read current passages and disclose weak or failed channels. Index freshness is
distinct from factual review dates.

## Choose the supported channel

| Operation | Channel and fallback |
|---|---|
| Read a Markdown page or source | CLI `read path=...`, or read its exact path under the known vault root. |
| Search | Prefer `search.mjs` and inspect its diagnostics. If a channel fails, use available results plus bounded filesystem `rg` over `wiki/` and `moc/`; include `raw/clippings/` only for evidence lookup. State missing channels. |

| Factual freshness report | `stale.mjs` may use CLI discovery or scoped filesystem fallback. Preserve missing-review and coverage diagnostics. |
| Ordinary Markdown creation/editing | Use exact-path filesystem edits even when the CLI is healthy, with the same operation, evidence, schema and validation contract. Read current content before editing; preserve unrelated changes. Never pass a whole note body through `content=`. |
| Small typed property or app actions | Use the guarded CLI entry point below; filesystem property edits remain available with schema validation. |
| Opening a note in the UI, executing an Obsidian/plugin command, app state, live Bases queries | Requires working Obsidian CLI. Report the specific unavailable action; continue independent file work. Do not pretend a filesystem approximation executed an app action. |

For CLI calls use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
or the bundled `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. These share an OS-managed lock across
agent processes, vaults and plugin copies for the same user. Do not launch native
`obsidian` directly or bypass a busy guard; other tools' raw calls are not protected.
The guard waits up to 10 seconds for a turn, then fails without sending a request.
Command execution has its own 10-second default timeout. Each request is limited
to a conservative 2,048-byte UTF-8 JSON envelope and rejects physical CR/LF/NUL.

use filesystem Markdown editing or narrow the read query; do not split a note

content directories; exclude `.recycle/`, dot folders, dependency trees and binary
originals. Do not recursively enumerate the entire user profile or scan a recycled
topic. Raw bodies remain immutable even during fallback. If target content changed
since it was read, reconcile it before writing; do not overwrite concurrent work.

## Shell portability

Examples elsewhere use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs"` as command
notation. Replace the placeholder with the actual installed absolute path before
execution, and set the vault for the operation's scope. Do not execute literal
angle-bracket placeholders or assume a relative `scripts/` path means the plugin.

```powershell
$wikiPriorVault = $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT
try {
  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = 'C:/absolute/path/to/vault'

}
```

```sh
WIKI_MASTER_VAULT='/absolute/path/to/vault' node '/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
```

the GUI executable instead of `Obsidian.com` and return misleading empty output.

21	   `--since=YYYY-MM-DD`, `--seed="wiki/concepts/<page>.md"`, or `--semantic`).
22	   Read both candidate pages and their supporting evidence. Choose a role and an
23	   explanatory sentence using the efficacy contract. A candidate is unverified;
24	   shared evidence and similarity do not establish equivalence or causality.

26	   seek input for uncertain interpretations. Supporting citations stay in

29	4. Build or refresh a small task MOC when it helps recurring questions: starting
30	   points, prerequisites, alternatives, complementary domains and open questions.
31	   Use `_templates/task-map.md`; keep generated document catalogs distinct.
32	   Confirm new links resolve and a task query can find the map. Write the log entry:
33	   `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/log-entry.mjs" --op relink --title "<summary>"` (details on stdin).

36	   (An `op-commit` with no `--paths-file` is refused while any other operation is open; scope it with `op-ledger.mjs show --since <saved-token> --out <ledger>` and `--paths-file <ledger>`.)
37	   Relink rewrites links across the graph; committing it as one unit is what makes
38	   it revertable. The helper does not push; push and verify remote publication through the shared contract. This step also reports any hard-wrapped wikilink
39	   still present in the files it commits, in case one was introduced after step 1 ran.

1	# Keeping knowledge findable and trustworthy
2	
3	Use this contract when creating concepts, linking topics, discovering sources or reviewing answers. The schema stays small; explanatory prose supplies the nuance.
4	
5	## Concept identity
6	
7	Before creating a concept, search its intended title, common alternative wording, and the nearest existing concepts. Choose explicitly: extend the canonical page, add an equivalent alias, or create a distinct concept with a scope boundary. Run `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/identity-audit.mjs" --json` from the plugin root when ambiguity is suspected. Never merge based on embedding similarity alone.
8	
9	Use `aliases: ["equivalent phrase"]` and a one-sentence `scope:` on concept pages. Aliases name the same concept; broader, narrower and complementary concepts remain separate pages. Use full-path wikilinks for ambiguous names. A source page and a concept may legitimately share a basename; a warning is a review queue, not permission to rename everything.
10	
11	## Relationships and citations
12	
13	Keep citations in `sources:` and in the prose they support. Citation targets point to `wiki/sources/` or `raw/`, using full paths when needed. A source page must identify its own raw clipping. Reachable evidence establishes a citation route, not that a claim is true or entailed by it.
14	
15	Put navigation in `## Relationships` or `Related:`. Use a small role vocabulary: **broader**, **narrower**, **prerequisite**, **complements**, **alternative**, **contrasts**, **applies-to**. Each link needs a sentence explaining the relationship and its limits. For example: `Complements [[wiki/concepts/Intention-Action Gap.md|Intention–Action Gap]]: this intervention addresses a gap between intending and acting under the conditions described above.` Do not turn similar wording into a causal claim. Clearly label cross-source interpretations as synthesis; retain their supporting citations outside the navigation section.
16	
17	Run `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/relationships.mjs" --limit=10 --json` to generate candidates. Shared sources and semantic neighbors are reasons to inspect, never proof of a relationship. Review both pages and their evidence; accept only links with a useful explanation. Reuse existing user authorization for the requested relink scope. Do not grow links merely to improve a graph score.
18	
19	## Task maps and discovery
20	
21	Curated `moc/` maps answer a recurring task: where to start, prerequisites, competing approaches, complementary domains, and unresolved questions. Keep generated project catalogs as a section or separate linked page. Search indexes both wiki pages and MOCs. Maintain a few useful maps instead of a universal taxonomy.
22	
23	Discovery starts with an unanswered question and bounded search of the existing wiki/MOCs. Each candidate source must state what evidence it adds and which existing or proposed concept/synthesis it changes. Deduplicate source URLs as before. Read the manual Start here section of `index.md` only if needed; never load its generated catalog as the default coverage summary. Promote high-use stubs and missing bridges when their current evidence is sufficient; do not pad stubs or enforce a source:synthesis ratio.
24	
25	## Verification and maintenance cadence
26	
27	- **Each ingest or substantive edit:** check identity and citation paths, update the affected task map, refresh the index through the operation helper. Update `updated` for edits; set `reviewed` only after checking factual claims against evidence or project behavior.
28	- **Each requested maintenance pass:** inspect structural defects, then sample changed/high-use pages even if the structural score is perfect. Run drift coverage first; choose a bounded sample for embeddings and claim inspection. Record evaluated, skipped and failed counts, plus document/chunk sampling coverage. Long documents are sampled; a page counted as evaluated is not an exhaustive factual review.
29	- **Weekly when actively growing:** review up to ten relationship candidates, high-demand stubs and discovery gaps. This is a workflow cadence, not an installed scheduler.
30	- **After search/schema changes and periodically as vocabulary evolves:** run the retrieval regression set, inspect development failures, then measure held-out queries without tuning to them. Keep results by category rather than one misleading health score.
31	
32	`reviewed` means factual verification; `updated` means edited; search index freshness means the indexed file version matches the file. None substitutes for the others. Missing review dates remain unverified. Cosine drift is a topical diagnostic, not a truth or contradiction detector. A zero-evaluated run cannot justify saying the wiki has no drift.
33	
34	Read [wiki efficacy](../../../docs/wiki-efficacy.md) for command contracts and evaluation examples.
35

# Keeping knowledge findable and trustworthy

Use this contract when creating concepts, linking topics, discovering sources or reviewing answers. The schema stays small; explanatory prose supplies the nuance.

## Concept identity

Before creating a concept, search its intended title, common alternative wording, and the nearest existing concepts. Choose explicitly: extend the canonical page, add an equivalent alias, or create a distinct concept with a scope boundary. Run `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/identity-audit.mjs" --json` from the plugin root when ambiguity is suspected. Never merge based on embedding similarity alone.

Use `aliases: ["equivalent phrase"]` and a one-sentence `scope:` on concept pages. Aliases name the same concept; broader, narrower and complementary concepts remain separate pages. Use full-path wikilinks for ambiguous names. A source page and a concept may legitimately share a basename; a warning is a review queue, not permission to rename everything.

## Relationships and citations

Keep citations in `sources:` and in the prose they support. Citation targets point to `wiki/sources/` or `raw/`, using full paths when needed. A source page must identify its own raw clipping. Reachable evidence establishes a citation route, not that a claim is true or entailed by it.

Put navigation in `## Relationships` or `Related:`. Use a small role vocabulary: **broader**, **narrower**, **prerequisite**, **complements**, **alternative**, **contrasts**, **applies-to**. Each link needs a sentence explaining the relationship and its limits. For example: `Complements [[wiki/concepts/Intention-Action Gap.md|Intention–Action Gap]]: this intervention addresses a gap between intending and acting under the conditions described above.` Do not turn similar wording into a causal claim. Clearly label cross-source interpretations as synthesis; retain their supporting citations outside the navigation section.

Run `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/relationships.mjs" --limit=10 --json` to generate candidates. Shared sources and semantic neighbors are reasons to inspect, never proof of a relationship. Review both pages and their evidence; accept only links with a useful explanation. Reuse existing user authorization for the requested relink scope. Do not grow links merely to improve a graph score.

## Task maps and discovery

Curated `moc/` maps answer a recurring task: where to start, prerequisites, competing approaches, complementary domains, and unresolved questions. Keep generated project catalogs as a section or separate linked page. Search indexes both wiki pages and MOCs. Maintain a few useful maps instead of a universal taxonomy.

Discovery starts with an unanswered question and bounded search of the existing wiki/MOCs. Each candidate source must state what evidence it adds and which existing or proposed concept/synthesis it changes. Deduplicate source URLs as before. Read the manual Start here section of `index.md` only if needed; never load its generated catalog as the default coverage summary. Promote high-use stubs and missing bridges when their current evidence is sufficient; do not pad stubs or enforce a source:synthesis ratio.

## Verification and maintenance cadence

- **Each ingest or substantive edit:** check identity and citation paths, update the affected task map, refresh the index through the operation helper. Update `updated` for edits; set `reviewed` only after checking factual claims against evidence or project behavior.
- **Each requested maintenance pass:** inspect structural defects, then sample changed/high-use pages even if the structural score is perfect. Run drift coverage first; choose a bounded sample for embeddings and claim inspection. Record evaluated, skipped and failed counts, plus document/chunk sampling coverage. Long documents are sampled; a page counted as evaluated is not an exhaustive factual review.
- **Weekly when actively growing:** review up to ten relationship candidates, high-demand stubs and discovery gaps. This is a workflow cadence, not an installed scheduler.
- **After search/schema changes and periodically as vocabulary evolves:** run the retrieval regression set, inspect development failures, then measure held-out queries without tuning to them. Keep results by category rather than one misleading health score.

`reviewed` means factual verification; `updated` means edited; search index freshness means the indexed file version matches the file. None substitutes for the others. Missing review dates remain unverified. Cosine drift is a topical diagnostic, not a truth or contradiction detector. A zero-evaluated run cannot justify saying the wiki has no drift.

Read [wiki efficacy](../../../docs/wiki-efficacy.md) for command contracts and evaluation examples.
